molecule (table)

- label: TEXT
PRIMARY KEY (molecule_id)

- atom_id: TEXT NOT NULL
- molecule_id: TEXT
- element: TEXT

arguments.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS connection_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id) AS bond_ids,
       SUM(c.atom_id < c.atom_id2) AS forward_rows
FROM main.connected AS c
JOIN main.bond AS b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN main.molecule AS m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
JOIN main.atom AS a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN main.atom AS a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE m.label = '+' AND b.bond_type = '=' AND a1.element = 'c' AND a2.element = 'c';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS connection_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id) AS bond_ids,
       SUM(c.atom_id < c.atom_id2) AS forward_rows
FROM main.connected AS c
JOIN main.bond AS b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN main.molecule AS m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
JOIN main.atom AS a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN main.atom AS a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE m.label = '+' AND b.bond_type = '=' AND a1.element = 'c' AND a2.element = 'c';
